assessment.summary: This study genotyped Anopheles gambiae from 13 sites in the Comoros and 1 site in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, collected in 2011. It assessed the presence of the kdr-East (L1014S) mutation and the CYP9K1 cyp3 allele. Results showed that Comoros populations were homozygous for the susceptible kdr allele, while 96% of the Dar es Salaam population carried the resistant L1014S allele.
